output_dir.description: The base directory where extracted archives are placed.

continue_on_error.description: If true, adds the -f flag to continue even if program availability checks fail or directory collision occurs.

special_helper.description: If true, adds the -u flag for special helper mode (create directory and extract there).

smart_mode.description: If true, adds the -U flag for smart mode.

show_formats.description: If true, adds the -s flag to show supported formats instead of extracting.

dry_run.description: If true, adds the --dry-run flag to display calculated commands without running them.

verbose.description: If true, adds the -v flag for more verbosity.

tool_options.description: List of arguments to pass to external programs (e.g., -C /tmp). Only applies to archive tools, not unp itself.

files.description: List of compressed file paths to unpack.
